changes.text: 足额口粮只够五个星期，一条脆弱的小船，六个名额。队长要说服全队走一条胜算很小的路，还要否掉带病号上船的提议，并在开船前把整支队伍交到留守者手里。

Full rations for five weeks, one fragile boat, six places. The captain had to talk the whole party into a long-odds voyage, veto a proposal to take a sick man along, and hand the stranded party over to the man staying behind before the boat pulled away.
摆在面前的出路只有一条：派人乘小船出海求援，而且不能拖。记述里写这一句时没有回旋余地——「That conclusion was forced upon me」，这个结论是被逼出来的。
One way out remained: take a boat for help, and do it now. The account leaves no room to maneuver — "That conclusion was forced upon me". The conclusion was forced on him.
有人提议把双脚冻伤的 Blackborrow 带上船，让他尽快得到温暖和庇护。队长否掉了这个提议。记录里给的理由是存活推断：健康的人在船上都难活，重病躺在舱底、动弹不得的人，熬不过必定会遇到的坏天气。

One proposal was to take Blackborrow, the man with the frostbitten feet, so that he could have shelter and warmth as quickly as possible. The captain vetoed it. The record gives survival reasoning: fit men would find it hard enough to live in the boat, and a sick man lying helpless in the bottom could not be expected to survive the heavy weather they were sure to encounter.
拼凑出来的东西很简陋，但足以给一层帆布覆罩打底。帆布冻得硬邦邦，只能先裁好，再在脂肪炉上一英尺一英尺地烤开，才能缝成覆罩，最后钉好、拧紧。覆罩装上后确实给了小船一层安全的样子，可队长心里不踏实，觉得它「bore a strong likeness to stage scenery」——看着像花岗石墙，其实不过是帆布和板条。事后证明，这层覆罩确实顶用。

What was put together was a patched-up affair, but it provided a base for a canvas covering. The canvas came frozen stiff; it had to be cut and then thawed over the blubber stove foot by foot before it could be sewn into a cover, then nailed and screwed into position. The cover did lend the boat an appearance of safety, but the captain felt uneasy that "it bore a strong likeness to stage scenery" — a wall that looks like granite and is in fact no better than canvas and lath. As events proved, the covering served its purpose well.
有一天上午 11 点前后，缆绳断了，海锚丢失，船横倒进涌里，向下风漂去。那是不必冒险在大风中升帆也能让船头顶浪的唯一手段，连同宝贵的绳子都找不回来，只能敲掉帆上的冰，升帆赌它撑得住。航程中一次测算显示：已走 380 多英里，接近南乔治亚的一半。看样子能撑过去。

About 11 a.m. one day the painter parted and the sea-anchor went — the only means of keeping the boat's head up to the seas without the risk of hoisting sail in a gale, lost along with the valuable rope. She fell off into the trough and drifted to leeward. They beat the ice off the frozen canvas and hoisted it, trusting it to hold. One reckoning showed over 380 miles done, getting on for half-way to South Georgia. It looked as though they were going to get through.

航程中有一次，遇上了队长二十六年海上经历中从未见过的巨浪，与多日来那些白浪翻卷的大浪完全不同。他高喊大家抓紧。船被像软木塞一样抛起、向前甩出，灌进半船水，在重击下颤抖；所有人拼命用随手抓到的容器掏水，十分钟后才觉得船重新有了生命。Vincent 在过去一周已不再是积极的船员，队长写明难以解释他的垮掉——他是船上体格最强壮的人之一，年轻，在北海拖网船上干过，本该比 McCarthy 更能吃苦，而 McCarthy 没那么强壮，却总是乐呵呵的。淡水减到每人每天半品脱。带上船的冰块早已用完，装船时一只水桶在浪里被撞裂，渗进了一些海水，喝的水发咸，渴得更厉害；队长不肯增加配给，有人恳求预支第二天的水，也被拒绝：万一风向不利，船可能被吹离海岛，航程拖长许多天，而缺水是人所能承受的最严酷的匮乏。

At one point came a wave beyond anything the captain had met in twenty-six years at sea — a mighty upheaval of the ocean, quite apart from the white-capped seas that had been their tireless enemies for many days. He shouted for everyone to hold on: "It's got us!" The boat was lifted and flung forward like a cork, half-full of water and shuddering under the blow; the men baled with the energy of men fighting for life, and after ten minutes of uncertainty felt her renew her life beneath them. Vincent had for the past week ceased to be an active member of the crew, and the captain could not easily account for his collapse: physically one of the strongest men in the boat, young, with service on North Sea trawlers, he should have borne hardship better than McCarthy, who was not so strong but always happy. The daily water allowance was cut to half a pint a man. The lumps of ice taken aboard were long gone, and the breaker had been slightly stove in during loading, letting in some sea-water, so the brackish water sharpened the thirst; the captain would not raise the allowance or let anyone draw against the morrow's, however he was begged — should the wind turn unfavourable, it might drive them away from the island and lengthen the voyage by many days, and lack of water is the severest privation men can be condemned to endure.

dispositions.rationale: 中文改为“足额口粮只够五个星期”，英文改为“Full rations for five weeks”。这样明确限定为足额配给，与 hook.0 所写减量可撑三个月一致。

evidence.quote: we had full rations for the whole party for a period of five weeks

dispositions.rationale: 英文末句改为“The conclusion was forced on him.”，不再暗示决定由他人作出，与原文和中文“这个结论是被逼出来的”对应。没有补写原文未写明的施动者。中文未改动，按中英同步规则一并给出。

evidence.quote: That conclusion was forced upon me

dispositions.rationale: 英文删去评判性的“not a moral position”，该判断留给 analysis.1 的解释段。中文补上病号姓名 Blackborrow，中英统一点名。

evidence.quote: They suggested that I should take Blackborrow in order that he might have shelter and warmth as quickly ag possible, but I had to veto this idea

dispositions.rationale: 删去无据的“骨架凑合而成”和扩大范围的“改船的活全是”。中英都改为只说那个拼凑出来的东西给帆布覆罩打底，不指认它具体是什么部件，也不扩大到整个改船工程。

evidence.quote: It was a patched-up affair, but it provided a base for a canvas covering

dispositions.rationale: 中文“后来一次测算”改为“航程中一次测算”，英文“A later reckoning”改为“One reckoning”。证据未写明测算与海锚丢失的先后，因此不再断定顺序。

evidence.quote: We had done over 380 miles and were getting on for half-way to South Georgia

dispositions.rationale: 中文改为假设语气“万一风向不利，船可能被吹离海岛，航程拖长许多天”，并补回“吹离海岛”。英文同步改为假设语气，并补上 drive them away from the island。

evidence.quote: an unfavourable wind might drive us away from the island and lengthen our voyage by many days
